Privacy notice

How your details are used.

Last updated 24 September 2026.

Who I am

Wavesbychin is run by Vivi, a sole trader based in East London. I decide how the details you send through this site are used, which makes me the data controller under UK data protection law. You can reach me at wavesbychin@gmail.com.

What I collect

When you send a message: your email address, your message, and anything else you choose to fill in: your name, company, group size, preferred date and session format. If you tell me about a health condition, such as pregnancy, epilepsy or a pacemaker, I use it only to check a session is suitable for you and keep it only as long as your booking needs it.

When you join the mailing list: your email address.

If you accept analytics cookies: Google Analytics records which pages are visited, roughly where from, and on what kind of device. IP addresses are anonymised, and nothing is used for advertising. If you decline, no analytics cookies are set.

Your cookie choice is stored in your own browser so the banner does not keep asking.

Why, and on what basis

Messages are used to reply to you and, if you book, to arrange and deliver the session. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before a contract, and my legitimate interest in answering enquiries. The mailing list and analytics rely on your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

Where it goes

Form entries are stored in a database run by Supabase. A copy of each new entry is sent to me as a private Telegram message, so I can reply quickly. Email is handled through Google (Gmail), analytics through Google Analytics, and the site itself is hosted on GitHub Pages, which, like any web host, sees visitors' IP addresses. Fonts load from Google Fonts. Some of these providers store data outside the UK. Where they do, they use the safeguards UK law requires. Your details are never sold or shared for marketing.

How long I keep it

Messages are kept for up to two years after we last spoke, then deleted. Mailing-list addresses are kept until you unsubscribe. Records of paid bookings are kept for six years, because tax law requires it.

Your rights

You can ask to see the details I hold about you, have them corrected or deleted, object to how they are used, or withdraw consent. Email wavesbychin@gmail.com and I will reply within a month. To unsubscribe from the mailing list, reply to any email with “unsubscribe”.

If you are unhappy with how your details are handled, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk. I would appreciate the chance to put it right first.
